title: Those who rest faith on the Church mean a universal Church individuals never hear
source_text: XXIII. Adde quod, si qui fingant fidem nostram Ecclesiae authoritate niti, per Ecclesiam intelligunt Ecclesiam universalem. Atqui fideles singuli Ecclesiam illam non audiunt, sed plerique instituuntur ab Ecclesiis particularibus, et earum ministris, qui falli et errare possunt. Ac proinde fides eorum non potest niti Ecclesiae universae testimonio, quod ab ipsis nunquam auditum est.
pass_a_gloss: Add that, if any invent that our faith rests on the Church's authority, by Church they understand the universal Church. But individual believers do not hear that Church; rather most are instructed by particular churches and their ministers, who can be deceived and err. And therefore their faith cannot rest on the testimony of the universal Church, which has never been heard by them.
pass_b_english: Add this: those who invent that our faith rests on the Church's authority mean by "Church" the universal Church. But individual believers do not hear that Church. Most are instructed by particular churches and their ministers, who can be deceived and can err. So their faith cannot rest on the testimony of a universal Church they have never heard.
